title: Rainbow Timer
description: Adds a customizable rainbow timer to your game
body:
The rainbow timer mod adds a timer in rainbow colors in your actionbar that is customizable trough commands. There are five commands that you can use:

/timer resume (starts/ resumes timer)

/timer pause (pauses timer)

/timer set [x] [x] [x] [x] sets the timer to [x] days, hours, minutes and seconds

/timer reverse - will be available soon

/timer hide (Hides the timer)

/timer show (Makes the timer visible)
